title: Contrastive Energy Fields for Inference-Time Procedure Planning in Instructional Videos
abstract: arXiv:2608.16457v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Procedure planning seeks to estimate a sequence of actions to transition from an observed initial state to a given goal state. Current procedure planning approaches directly predict action sequences from latent representations using feed-forward neural networks or diffusion-based inference. These paradigms treat every action as plausible, lacking the ability to enforce task-specific logical constraints that render certain actions irrelevant or not plausible. We propose CEFITO, a procedure planning approach that learns a predictor to express an action-conditioned representation space. Based on this representation space, we formulate procedure planning as a task-constrained optimization problem. Unlike prior methods, CEFITO explicitly reasons over the action space by omitting irrelevant actions during inference-time planning. translated_title: 对比能量场用于教学视频中的推理时程序规划
translated_abstract: 程序规划旨在估计一系列动作，以从观察到的初始状态过渡到给定的目标状态。当前的程序规划方法通常使用前馈神经网络或基于扩散的推理直接从潜在表示预测动作序列。这些范式将每个动作视为可行，缺乏强制执行任务特定逻辑约束的能力，这些约束会使某些动作变得不相关或不可行。我们提出CEFITO，一种程序规划方法，它学习一个预测器来表达动作条件化的表示空间。基于该表示空间，我们将程序规划表述为一个受任务约束的优化问题。与先前方法不同，CEFITO通过在推理时规划中省略不相关动作，明确地对动作空间进行推理。这种重新表述使得有效的程序规划成为可能，并在两个既定基准上达到了最先进的准确性。
tldr: CEFITO通过将程序规划重新表述为受任务约束的优化问题，并在推理时显式省略不相关动作，实现了教学视频中程序规划的最先进准确性。
en_tdlr: CEFITO achieves state-of-the-art accuracy in instructional video procedure planning by reformulating it as a task-constrained optimization problem and explicitly omitting irrelevant actions during inference-time planning.
